description: Source code for stock management in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including classes for stock locations, incoterms, stock tracking, and stock picking operations.

classes.name: stock_incoterms
classes.description: Model representing Incoterms with name, code, and active status.

classes.name: stock_location
classes.description: Model representing stock locations with hierarchical structure, stock quantities, and related operations.

classes.name: stock_tracking
classes.description: Model for tracking stock lots with SSCC checksum generation.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Model for managing stock pickings (delivery or receipt operations), including state transitions and move management.

methods.name: _complete_name
methods.description: Computes full hierarchical name of a stock location.

methods.name: _product_qty_available
methods.description: Calculates available stock quantities for locations.

methods.name: product_detail
methods.description: Retrieves detailed product value information for a location.

methods.name: _product_value
methods.description: Calculates total stock value for locations.

methods.name: chained_location_get
methods.description: Determines chained location based on location type and partner.

methods.name: picking_type_get
methods.description: Determines picking type ('delivery', 'in') based on source and destination locations.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms a stock picking and its moves.

methods.name: action_move
methods.description: Marks moves as done if assigned.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a stock picking and its moves.

methods.name: action_done
methods.description: Marks a stock picking as done.

methods.name: get_currency_id
methods.description: Returns currency ID for a picking (stub).

methods.name: _get_payment_term
methods.description: Retrieves payment term for a picking.

methods.name: _get_address_invoice
methods.description: Retrieves invoice address for a picking.

methods.name: _get_comment_invoice
methods.description: Retrieves invoice comment for a picking.

methods.name: _get_price_unit_invoice
methods.description: Retrieves unit price for invoice line.
